advertisements.title: Marine Engineer, Class I
advertisements.disability: Specific Learning Disability (SLD), 40–100%, one reserved post

notes: Two separate GPSC advertisement/application numbers share identical bilingual 28-page detailed-PDF bytes; each gets one application cycle. Do not count four document URLs or two vacancies as four cycles.

English PDF pages 8–12 support opening/closing times, post-specific disability ranges, marine credentials, experience, Gujarati-or-Hindi requirement and exam-medium caveat. Recruitment-rules scans are retained but require founder reading.

No national citizenship rule found in the detailed advertisement; international-applicant ability to apply, enter selection and take the board post remains needs verification. Foreign degree equivalency is separately mentioned and does not establish nationality permission.
These are Gujarat Maritime Board posts; the advertisement explicitly says selected persons are board employees, not Gujarat Government employees.
Other Gujarat advertisements, amendments and departments remain coverage gaps.
